name: NoForm
author: noform

sections.description:
Engage, qualify, and capture leads—automatically.

NoForm is your AI-powered sales assistant that works 24/7 to capture, qualify, and convert leads while giving your team the insights they need to close deals faster.

This plugin allows you to seamlessly integrate your NoForm chatbot into your WordPress website.

After installing the plugin, you enter your Bot ID in the plugin settings. Once configured, the plugin automatically injects the chatbot script into the site footer.

This plugin includes built-in validation to ensure the Bot ID format is correct and will not load anything if the Bot ID is missing or invalid.

Note: This plugin loads an external JavaScript file from NoForm servers. The chatbot functionality and any data processing are handled by NoForm and not by WordPress itself.

NoForm supports localization and loads translations based on the current WordPress locale, with automatic fallback to English if a translation is not available.

You can obtain a Bot ID by creating a chatbot at https://noform.ai/.

Key features:
* AI-powered conversations: GPT-based chatbot to answer visitor questions naturally.
* 24/7 lead qualification: Engages visitors around the clock and qualifies leads based on your criteria.
* Seamless lead capture: Collects email, phone, and custom attributes without traditional forms.
* Actionable insights: Generates conversation summaries to help your sales team close deals.
* Multilingual support: Built-in localization (EN, DE, ES, FR, PT, UA) with automatic fallback.
* Zero coding: Easy setup via a 24-character Bot ID validation.
* GDPR & CCPA compliant: Designed with data privacy and security in mind.

Why NoForm?

📈 78% of customers buy from the first company to respond. With NoForm, you’ll always be the first to start the conversation.

Perfect for:
Marketing & sales teams, Real Estate, Law firms, SaaS, E-commerce, Healthcare, and Service-based businesses.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for NoForm and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  4. Go to Settings > NoForm in your admin dashboard.
  5. Enter your Bot ID (found in your NoForm dashboard).
  6. Save changes—and your AI assistant is live!
sections.faq:
Do I need a NoForm account?

Yes, you need an account to create your chatbot and obtain your unique Bot ID. Sign up at https://noform.ai.

What is a Bot ID?

A Bot ID is a unique identifier provided by NoForm that links your website to a specific chatbot configuration.

What happens if I enter an invalid Bot ID?

The plugin will show a validation error and will not save the value. The chatbot script will not be loaded.

Does the plugin load anything if the Bot ID is empty?

No. If the Bot ID is empty, the plugin does not inject any scripts or affect the frontend.

Which languages are supported?

The plugin includes translations for English (default), German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, and Ukrainian.
If a translation is missing for the current locale, English is used automatically.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes! NoForm is compatible with all modern WordPress themes and page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.) by injecting the script safely into the footer.

How do I train the AI?

Inside the NoForm platform, you can train your AI by providing website URLs, uploading documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT), or adding manual instructions.
